Adapt only necessary seams and preserve resource/session/Origin/CAS/validation checks.

## AP-10 — subtask 2.3: exact-measure block appeal submit/review (2026-11-06)

- [Draft implementation PR #290](https://github.com/iliya1947/vico-forum/pull/290), **exact head `3c3574e1f1381ed0e9ec11e00c8ba20dc850f3a6`**. Earlier bounded slices 1.1 catalog, 1.2 migrations/grants, 2.1 authority, 2.2 measure create/change/lift remain in same PR. No merge/review requested before full AP-10 scope.
- `db/user-measures.ts`: `submitAppeal` allows authenticated subject == exact measure target, no blocks.manage or owner binding for own submission. Under shared authz lock, locks target and exact measure; checks terminal via PG `clock_timestamp()`; one pending and max 3 sequential committed appeals per measure (existing DB indexes retained), exact stable appeal UUID/body retry with original ordinal even after resolution/terminal, no extra slot. Different measures independently accept appeals.
- `resolveAppeal` uses **fresh raw hierarchical blocks.manage authority and stored issuer floor**, exact measure/appeal ID and expected version; reviewer outcome reject (unchanged version) or accept with lift/change of same measure. Accepted change **must be material**, no-op rejected; accepted lift preserves the reviewed appeal `accepted`, while ordinary lift retains moot pending behavior. Expired/lifted terminal cannot be revived; natural-expired pending is effectively moot at read boundary (stored status unchanged, no background writes).
- Canonical authz lock → target identity → measure FOR UPDATE → appeal lock → final shared Admin History advisory order. Common `applyLockedTransition` CAS/terminal primitive now serves ordinary change/lift **and** accepted appeal remedies, preventing parallel non-CAS path. Accepted change/lift/reject + reviewer explanation and one `measure.appealResolved` event atomic in single transaction; failed History forces rollback. Per-review operation UUID+fingerprint replay returns previous committed result without extra History even after later version/terminal.
- `db/admin-history.ts` typed measure appeal context extended with optional remedy; no public own DTO or admin routes yet (actor/reviewer identity still only internal). Pure tests: 2 added; native PostgreSQL real tests: 8 added (quota, pending/concurrency, independence, cross-subject, stale version, explicit lift and expiry, accepted change/lift, no-op/authority, History rollback).
